dominant_failure_modes.environment: historical subgates improve diagnosis but do not yet lift three repos over the paid gate
dominant_failure_modes.oracle: issue/PR candidates without changed tests are missing-oracle inventory only
dominant_failure_modes.source_context: commit-message-only remains common, especially where no linked issue/PR context was found

plain_language_summary: Broad local mining found more candidate anchors, but certified supply is still not paid-ready. The next useful move is to certify the v2 pool and repair weak source-context/oracle paths.

research_questions.RQ1: Yes. Current v1 artifacts reproduce the bottleneck: attrs/toolz/humanize remain below 30, boltons reaches 31 only after adding confirmed historical-environment recoveries.
research_questions.RQ2: Yes for raw candidate yield and source-reservoir visibility; not yet proven for certified yield because broad v2 candidates still need bounded certification execution.
research_questions.RQ3: Dominant modes are source context quality, missing oracle for issue-only candidates, and environment/reference subgates.
research_questions.RQ4: Repos projected at >=30: ['boltons']. The three-repo paid gate is not met.
research_questions.RQ5: SWE-smith, SWE-bench-Live, and R2E-style systems are feasible design references or future adapters; none is adopted or counted as default certified supply.
research_questions.RQ6: Paid validation, paid statement generation, benchmark release freeze, generated-oracle promotion, broad multi-language implementation, and ACUT harness work were not implemented and are tracked in the future-direction ledger.
research_questions.RQ7: Continue internal repo-history v2 on selected repos, then run a bounded certification pass; use external-source adapters only as later spikes.
